<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1217
Claimant:
Megan Gutierrez
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
01/24/2024
First notice of loss received for a side impact at an intersection, with the insured vehicle struck on the driver's side by
a vehicle that failed to yield. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through
the attorney's office.
02/25/2024
Confirmed that the driver is named on the poilcy and that coverage was in force at the time of the loss. Nothing in the
file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
02/27/2024
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact and lists the same
sequence of events the claimant described at intake.
03/04/2024
Scene photographs were obtained and confirm several details of the collision. No independent witnesses have been
identified beyond the parties and responding officers.
03/27/2024
Vehicle damage on the driver's side is consistent with the reported impact angle and location. No prior damage to the
same panels is recorded in the claim history or in the photos on file.
04/10/2024
Claimant reports a shoulder injury. The kind of injury and the force involved in the crash appear to align well, and no
earlier injury to the same body area is known from the medical history provided.
04/23/2024
Treatment followed a typical course, with physical therapy and follow-up visits tapering off as the claimant's condition
improved. The claimant's account has remained the same in every conversation to date.
04/28/2024
Medical records and billing have been requested through counsel. Reserves are being reviewed against the
treatment timeline as records arrive.
05/28/2024
File remains open pending receipt of the complete medical records and the attorney's demand package. Next review
is scheduled once those documents are received.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
